blocks.text: Jandaron mein proteins organic compounds ka bohat mukhtalif (diverse) group hain. Inhein mukhtalif bunyadon par baanta ja sakta hai. Maslan jandar mein kaam ke hisaab se yeh “structural proteins” aur “functional proteins” hain. Magar tajweez kardah (recommended) classification structure par mabni hai, jis mein proteins ko “fibrous proteins” (reshedar) aur “globular proteins” (gol) mein baanta jata hai. Dono ki khususiyaat ka muqabla Table 4.4 mein hai.
